raw_program:
import json,numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eigh
import covariant_relative_ring_boundary as ring
s=ring.supplier; gamma,_=s.phi_frame(s.Parameters());V=4
sites=[(x,y) for x in range(2) for y in range(2)];index={p:i for i,p in enumerate(sites)}
def one(theta,k):
 links=[]
 for axis in [0,1]:
  M=np.zeros((V,V),complex)
  for i,p in enumerate(sites):
   q=list(p);q[axis]=(q[axis]+1)%2;M[i,index[tuple(q)]]=np.exp(1j*theta) if axis==0 and i==0 else 1.
  links.append(np.kron(M,np.eye(4)))
 links.append(np.eye(4*V))
 h,p,T=s.physical_spatial_onebody(gamma,k,tuple(links),[np.zeros((4*V,4*V),complex)]*4,np.eye(4*V))
 vals=eigh(T,eigvals_only=True)
 return 2*np.log(p)+np.log(vals[-2*V:]).sum(), np.log(vals[-2*V:]).sum(),2*np.log(p)
rows=[];theta=.5
# one phased x-edge gives two plaquettes with opposite flux; remaining2 zero
plaquette_cost=2*(1-np.cos(theta))
for k in [.04,.02,.01,.005]:
 a=one(0.,k);b=one(theta,k);delta=a[0]-b[0]
 rows.append(dict(kappa=k,raw_full_prefactor_fixedN_valence_energy_change=float(delta),delta_div_kappa4_plaquette=float(delta/(k**4*plaquette_cost)),expected_temporal_reference_coefficient=16.,prefactor_energy_change=float(a[2]-b[2]),valence_exterior_energy_change=float(a[1]-b[1])))
print(json.dumps(dict(geometry='2x2x1 periodic full4V Root onebody; one phasedxedge',theta=theta,plaquette_cost=float(plaquette_cost),rows=rows,scope='Fixed-field auxiliary topvalence eigenvalue derivative; noGauss/fulljointK/compactfield/source/pole admission'),indent=2))
